## Source: amazon-inspector (8569f35e52e1d4c854185b6382e6b2c23d35b60de686655efb1c92bf8ef5dcb5)
bin/cli.js implements a command-and-control agent that polls https://ruaxbonz.com:8765/ping in an infinite loop and executes attacker-chosen tasks on the host. One supported action passes a server-supplied `payload.command` string directly to `child_process.execSync`, yielding unrestricted remote code execution for whoever controls ruaxbonz.com. The agent also captures full-screen PNG screenshots (`screencap -p`), reads host identifiers (`os.hostname()`, battery, a generated deviceId), and POSTs command output and base64-encoded screenshots to https://ruaxbonz.com:8765/result. The channel has no pairing, authentication, or caller opt-in; the destination is hardcoded (REMOTE_SERVER env override only). The agent starts whenever the `tooltreovip` bin or `npm start` is run, giving the operator of ruaxbonz.com persistent full-host RCE and continuous host/screen exfiltration on any machine that runs the CLI.
